checks.F1: celestial_counterexample is CORRECT and refutes these.tex:3645 under the thesis's own definition. Take X = susp(Bool) ≅ R and G = Perm Bool acting radially (the reflection). Analytic: faithful plus rigid, proved in celestial_counterexample_hypotheses. G = G_p is also proved there. φ = boolScale, (b,r) ↦ (b, ρ'(b)r), is full and ray-compatible. The third conjunct shows that its induced action is the coercion action, which Σ = Unit's structure uses, so Σ is a (G_p,X_p)-manifold for the INDUCED action, as the thesis requires. The cone charts of unitChart true/false reach radii 1 and 2 at ((),1), and G preserves radii, so the preatlas is not a (G,X)-atlas. Since no 'brouillard plus épais' exists over a non-préatlas, the proposition is false. The finding is robust in two ways. (i) {unitChart true, unitChart false} is itself a (Perm Bool, Bool)-atlas, so it does not depend on the maximal-atlas reading. (ii) The link Bool is compact, so it also holds in the thesis's quotient topology.
checks.minimal_fix: Radius preservation is SUFFICIENT, not NECESSARY, and not the minimal fix. Counterexample to necessity: X = R, G = R ≃ᵃ[ℝ] R (analytic), p = 0, H = G_p (all x ↦ ax), phi = (sphereSusp σ₀).symm with V = R (S(R) = {±1}), Sigma = a point with both charts to ±1 (a (G_p, X_p)-atlas, since a<0 swaps ±1). The two cone charts are r ↦ r and r ↦ -r. Their chart change is -id ∈ G, so the cone preatlas IS a (G,X)-atlas and the thesis's proposition HOLDS. But no ConicStructure exists for H = G_p: x ↦ x/2 is a contraction (GX.not_conicStructure_of_contraction, V = R, c = 1/2). The proof at these.tex:3667 needs only this: for each h ∈ H there is g_h ∈ G with phi(g_h·x) = susp(h·)(phi x), i.e. the link action lifts radially into G. Radius preservation is the special case g_h = h. When G ⊆ Isom (Euclidean or Poincaré), any such g_h is linear and induces h's ray map, so g_h = h and the two conditions coincide.
checks.sorry_closable: Yes, and NOT by invariance of domain. Suppose (x,t) ∈ Reg. Take a box W = mk(B × ]t-δ,t+δ[) in ψ's source, with B a connected open neighbourhood of x; since Reg Σ is portly, B ∩ Reg is connected. Continue along B ∩ Reg to get one g₀ ∈ G with f := φ ∘ g₀⁻¹ ∘ ψ = susp(e) locally on (B∩Reg) × I, for charts e of Σ's maximal atlas related by H. By density and continuity, f preserves r and f(y,s) = (e'(y), s), with e'(y) independent of s (T2Space L). So f(W) = mk(e'(B) × I), and its openness gives e'(B) open. e' is injective and continuous with continuous inverse, so it is a chart of Σ at x, compatible by the insertion trick of apex_mem_reg_model. Hence x ∈ Reg. The one genuine gap is the tag's 'g⁻¹ψ lands only in closure U'. It is closed by [CompactSpace L]: φ⁻¹ of L × [t/2, 2t] is compact, hence closed in T2 X, and lies in U. All intended links are compact (S^n, HS² ≅ S²). Estimate 250–400 lines. The general non-compact statement as written is unproved, possibly false.

summary: The build is green, with exactly one tagged sorry (celestial_sing_ray). The counterexample celestial_counterexample (F1) is sound, its hypotheses are satisfiable and checked (celestial_counterexample_hypotheses), and it is robust to the atlas and topology readings: the thesis's proposition l.3645 is false under its own definition. Major: the file and REPORT call radius preservation 'necessary'. It is only sufficient: on (Aff(R),R) at 0 the proposition holds while no ConicStructure exists. The minimal fix is the existence of a radial lift g_h ∈ G of each link action, which equals radius preservation for G ⊆ Isom. The sorry is closable without invariance of domain under [CompactSpace L].
